EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KURUNEGALAPRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Muslim Congress, the recognized political party to which JipriThikrulla the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide uponreturned member if Sri Lanka Muslim Congress who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of theLocal Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30)days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Mohamad Munas Mohomad Museen to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Gamalathge Dilip Nishantha, Returning Officer of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatMohamad Munas Mohomad Museen was selected as the member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DILIP NISHANTHA,Returning Officer,Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Kurunegala,02nd April, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
